macros.name: AddToReset
macros.doc: This macro adds the counters given in the comma separated list in the first argument to the reset list of the driver counter given in the 2nd argument.

macros.name: CascadeSuspendCounters
macros.doc: This macro is more powerful than \SuspendCounters, since it tries to detect whether a counter has a reset list and ’mutes’ the counters on this list as well and checks whether those counters themselves have reset lists and cascades down to the final state.

macros.name: ClearCounterResetList
macros.doc: This macro removes all counters of the given driver counter reset list.

macros.name: ClearCoupledCounters
macros.doc: This removes all names from the given name of a group of coupled counters.

macros.name: CopyDocumentCounters
macros.doc: copies the counter value from the source counter in argument 2 to the target counter in argument 3.

macros.name: CounterFullResetList
macros.doc: This macro determines the full reset list of a counter as well of the counters being on the reset list, i.e. the list is tracked down until there are no counters left in a recursion.

macros.name: countersresetlistcount
macros.doc: This macro determines the number of counters being in the reset list of the counter specified as mandatory argument.

macros.name: DeclareCoupledCountersGroup
macros.doc: This macro defines a name for a counter group and allocates a new group list for the counter names.

macros.name: DeclarePeriodicCounter
macros.doc: This defines the counter given in the first mandatory argument as a periodic counter and is automatically reset if the treshold value is reached.

macros.name: DisplayResetList
macros.doc: This command displays the reset list of a counter as a separated list.

macros.name: FormerBackupCounterValues
macros.doc: This macro adds counter names (separated by a comma) to a list and stores the current values of the counters to another list.

macros.name: FormerRemoveBackupCounters
macros.doc: This macro removes the counters from the list of backup counters and immediately restores the counter value unless the starred version \FormerRemoveBackupCounters* is used.

macros.name: FormerRestoreAllCounterValues
macros.doc: This macro restores all stored counter values corresponding to the counter names.

macros.name: FormerRestoreCounterValues
macros.doc: This macro restores only the stored counter values given by the counter names.

macros.name: GetAllResetLists
macros.doc: This determines all reset lists and stores the information internally.

macros.name: GetDriverCounter
macros.doc: This commands returns the driver counter to which the counter name of the first argument is connected to.

macros.name: getresetlistcount
macros.doc: This macro returns the number of counters being in the reset list of the counter specified as mandatory argument.

macros.name: HexValue
macros.doc: This command will print the value of the counter using uppercase hexadecimal digits.

macros.name: IfIsDocumentCounterF
macros.doc: This command executes only if the name is not a counter.

macros.name: IfIsDocumentCounterT
macros.doc: This command executes only if the name is a counter.

macros.name: IsAssociatedCounter
macros.doc: This commands tests, whether a given counter name is an associated counter and expands correspondingly the true or the false branch.

macros.name: IsAssociatedToCounter
macros.doc: This macro checks, whether a counter is associated to a particular given driver counter and expands the corresponding branch.

macros.name: IsCoupledCounterF
macros.doc: This macro tests if a counter is under the administration of the coupled counter commands and executes the false branch then if this is not the case.

macros.name: IsCoupledCounterT
macros.doc: This macro tests if a counter is under the administration of the coupled counter commands and executes the true branch then.

macros.name: IsCoupledCounterTF
macros.doc: This macro tests if a counter is under the administration of the coupled counter commands and expands to the relevant branch then.

macros.name: IsDriverCounter
macros.doc: This commands tests, whether a given counter name is a driver counter and expands correspondingly the true or the false branch.

macros.name: IsPeriodicCounterTF
macros.doc: This macro tests if a counter is under the administration of the periodic counter commands and expands to the relevant branch then.

macros.name: IsSuperTotalCounterF
macros.doc: This macro checks if a counter is under the administration of the super total counter commands and expands to the code in the second argument if this is not the case.

macros.name: IsSuperTotalCounterT
macros.doc: This macro checks if a counter is under the administration of the super total counter commands and expands to the code in the second argument if this is true.

macros.name: IsSuperTotalCounterTF
macros.doc: This macro tests if a counter is under the administration of the super total counter commands and expands to the relevant branch then.

macros.name: IsTotalCounterF
macros.doc: This macro checks if a counter is under the administration of the total counter commands and expands to the code in the second argument if this is not the case.

macros.name: IsTotalCounterT
macros.doc: This macro checks if a counter is under the administration of the total counter commands and expands to the code in the second argument if this is true.

macros.name: IsTotalCounterTF
macros.doc: This macro tests if a counter is under the administration of the total counter commands and expands to the relevant branch then.

macros.name: LastAddedToCounter
macros.doc: This command has no arguments and expands to the name of the counter which was used last in \addtocounter.

macros.name: LastCounterValue
macros.doc: This command has no arguments and expands to the value of the very last change of a counter, i.e. using \setcounter etc.

macros.name: LastRefSteppedCounter
macros.doc: This macro gives the last counter being used in \refstepcounter and is expandable.

macros.name: LastSetCounter
macros.doc: This command has no arguments and expands to the name of the counter which was set last using \setcounter.

macros.name: LastSteppedCounter
macros.doc: This command has no arguments and expands to the name of the counter which was stepped last using \stepcounter.

macros.name: LoopRefstepCounters
macros.doc: All counters given in the first argument are stepped using the regular \refstepcounter to allow labels – however, only the last counter will have the correct label reference.

macros.name: LoopResetCounters
macros.doc: All counters given in the first argument are set to zero using the regular \setcounter.

macros.name: OctalValue
macros.doc: This command will print the value of the counter using octal digits.

macros.name: RegisterPostLabelHook
macros.doc: This macro declares a possible list of hooks (commands) that should be executed after the traditional \label command is applied.

macros.name: RegisterPreLabelHook
macros.doc: This macro declares a possible list of hooks (commands) that should be executed before the traditional \label command is applied.

macros.name: RemoveAssociatedCounter
macros.doc: This command removes a counter from the existing list for a driver counter, i.e. the counter will not be increased any longer by \stepcounter.

macros.name: RemoveAssociatedCounters
macros.doc: This command removes the comma-separated-value list of counters from the existing list for a driver counter, i.e. the counters will not be increased any longer by \stepcounter.

macros.name: RemoveCounterFormats
macros.doc: Removes the given counter formats from the global list.

macros.name: RemoveFromFullReset
macros.doc: This macro removes the counters given in the comma separated list in the first argument and all of its own reset list from the reset list of the driver counter given in the 2nd argument.

macros.name: RemoveFromReset
macros.doc: This macro removes the counters given in the comma separated list in the first argument from the reset list of the driver counter given in the 2nd argument.

macros.name: RemovePeriodicCounter
macros.doc: This removes the counter given in the first mandatory argument as a periodic counter.

macros.name: ResumeAllSuspendedCounters
macros.doc: This command revokes all suspended counters.

macros.name: SetDocumentCounter
macros.doc: This command behaves like the standard macro \setcounter, but has an additional optional 1st argument.

macros.name: ShowResetList
macros.doc: This command displays the reset list of a counter on the terminal as the \show command would do.

macros.name: StepDownCounter
macros.doc: This macro subtracts the value of 1 from the counter and is the counterpart of \stepcounter.

macros.name: TotalCounterInternalName
macros.doc: This command reports the internal name of a total counter or the usual name if this counter is not a total one.
